responsibility: Provides the rx-linux target override header that specializes the generic RX backend for GNU/Linux ELF output. It redefines predefined macros, cc1/assembler specs, section directives, symbol and alignment emission, string/common-object assembly syntax, and other assembler-output hooks so the RX port emits Linux-compatible ELF assembly and startup conventions while still relying on the core definitions in rx.h.
